connectivity: The alpha-aryl-substituted trifluoroethyl ketone forms a monofluoroenone with the newly introduced phenyl group and retained fluorine on the same alkene carbon; the net loss is two fluorines.
starting_material_and_activation: Net conversion from a CF3 starting material is supported. Initial activation and transfer to the seed substrate are not established.
donor_form: Phenylboronic acid is the recorded input; the operative boron/palladium transfer species is not identified.
conditions: K3PO4/toluene/110 °C differs from the seed KHCO3/DCE/80 °C window. The original printed palladium formula, duration and equivalence basis remain unresolved.
product_persistence: Isolation in the source does not establish stability against further defluorination in the seed conditions.
interpretation: Conditional near-seed structural precedent; no general claim of heteroatom-donor compatibility or new partner discovery.
publication_locator: Physical PDF pp. 3 and 5; Scheme 3 structures 3a and 5.

connectivity: Imidazole nitrogen and retained fluorine occupy the same alkene carbon in the source product.
starting_material_and_activation: The source starts from a preformed gem-difluoroalkene bearing aryl and remote cyclobutanol substituents. It does not establish initial activation of the seed CF3 carbonyl substrate.
donor_form: Imidazole and Cs2CO3 inputs do not distinguish neutral-nitrogen capture from an anionic reacting species.
conditions: Cs2CO3/dry MeCN/80 °C; no added palladium is listed. The scheme states 24 h and the procedure states 12 h. Compatibility with the seed palladium conditions is unknown.
product_persistence: An isolable source monofluoroalkene does not establish persistence of the project carbonyl-containing C(F)–N target under the seed conditions.
interpretation: A local C–N connectivity precedent for targeted testing. The earlier non-transferable label concerns the seed C–C cycle; it is neither an observed failure of imidazole or all nitrogen donors nor a success prediction for the seed target.
publication_locator: Supporting Information, physical PDF pp. 65–66; downstream product 7 and its characterization.

connectivity: Alkoxide substitution gives beta-OR while fluorine remains at the alpha carbon of the butenolide. Oxygen and retained fluorine are on different alkene carbons, unlike the project C(F)–O target.
starting_material_and_activation: The starting difluorobutenolide has fluorines on different alkene carbons; it is neither a CF3 precursor nor a gem-difluoroalkene.
donor_form: Sodium/lithium alkoxides are supported in the source. Their formation and effective concentration in the seed weak-base conditions are unknown.
conditions: Source sodium or sodium-hydride/alcohol/ether procedures do not establish compatibility with the seed palladium/KHCO3/DCE system. Solvent, temperature and procedure-label inconsistencies remain in the source table/procedure.
product_persistence: The different product topology cannot establish stability of the project C(F)–O endpoint.
interpretation: Local regioselective vinylic-substitution context. It does not directly support the target C(F)–O connectivity, two net fluorine losses from CF3, or exclusion of the oxygen-donor family.
publication_locator: Physical PDF p. 2, Results and discussion, Reactions of oxyanions; Scheme 1.
